description: Renovate runs against the Gitea source repository. The GitHub repository receives the updates through the one-way export.

packageRules.description: One pull request per week for Go module minor and patch updates.
The Go toolchain moves with the golang base image digest.
deadfin-web is the bundled web client (Dockerfile DEADFIN_WEB_IMAGE). Open a pull request as soon as each release, rc included, is published; the release order in docs/releases.md waits on it.
One pull request per week for GitHub Actions digests.
